title: Maximum area of skylights.
officialText:
Each skylight shall have a maximum area within the curb of 100 square feet (9.3 m2).
Exception: The area limitation shall not apply where the building is equipped throughout with an automatic sprinkler system in
accordance with Section 903.3.1.1 or the building is equipped with smoke and heat vents in accordance with Section 910.
